AI Network Threat Detector

Sequential ML pipeline trained on UNSW-NB15 (82,332 network flows): binary classifier Normal/Attack (90% accuracy) + multi-class identifying 9 attack types (DoS, Exploits, Reconnaissance…) with 76% accuracy. CSV & PCAP input support via TShark + NFStream.

VitalBuddy — Health LLM

Full-stack app with dynamic 6-category adaptive quiz (nutrition, psychology, sleep…). Questions adapt to prior answers via JavaScript. GPT-3.5 Turbo generates personalized recommendations, motivation, and health warnings per user. Firebase Auth + Firestore session history.

Student Performance Assistant

Hybrid AI architecture: rule-based classification engine (Weak / Average / Good) + 7-day algorithmic planner prioritizing weak subjects. GPT-3.5 Turbo generates a full personalized report with 4 concrete recommendations, academic risk warnings, and motivational content.

Malware Detector — TensorFlow
